The as-cast samples were cut into pieces and wrapped in Nb foil (for heat treatment temperatures <1700 °C) or Ta foil (for heat treatment temperatures >1700 °C) and heat treated at 1500 °C (100 h), 1650 °C (50 h), 1700 °C (100 h), 1800 °C (20 h), 1900 °C (20 h), and 1950 °C (5 h), respectively.

records.quote: The upper stability temperature of the Hf5Si3 phase was estimated at 2360 ± 30 °C, based on the incipient melting and collapsing data of Brukl [1968Bru].
